turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How has voice cloning worked for your use case?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Cloning our lead anchor's voice for automated news summaries took under 10 minutes of sample audio and the result was shockingly close. Listeners genuinely couldn't tell in an internal test.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Any concerns about voice cloning as a feature?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We appreciate that you require consent verification before cloning goes live — that's the right call given how realistic it is. Just wanted to say that's noticed and appreciated.
